strain_assembly: K-12 substr. MG1655 (NC_000913.3) + planted 20 kb segmental duplication
name: k12_mg1655_segdup
key_challenge: Multi-mapping and locus-dedup correctness: a 20 kb repeat pair at 99.0% identity inside a natural genome

construction.description: Copy MG1655[1,500,000:1,520,000) (copy A), mutate to 99.0% identity (10% of changes single-base indels), insert at original coordinate 3,200,000 (copy B). Coordinates of both copies in the new reference are written to segdup_truth.bed.
commands: python3 {benchmark_dir}/scripts/build_embedded_segdup.py --ref base.fasta --src-start 1500000 --length 20000 --insert-at 3200000 --identity 99.0 --seed {seed} --out reference.fasta --truth-bed segdup_truth.bed && rm base.fasta

simulation.notes: Every read overlaps copy A or copy B. read_error is the per-base error-EVENT rate (substitutions + indel events); indel events average ~2 bp, so base-level edit divergence is ~1.7x the stated value.

truth.simulated: reads_1.fq.truth.tsv beside the reads: read_id chrom true_start strand true_end n_subs n_ins n_del indel_events. true_start is the 0-based leftmost reference coordinate; true_end is half-open. Score placement within +/-100 bp (long_read_accuracy.py).
truth.segdup: data/reference/segdup_truth.bed gives both copies. A read is simulated from exactly one copy (see reads_1.fq.truth.tsv) but a read lying wholly inside the repeat is a 99%-identity tie between the copies by design.

benchmark_notes: PA is ambiguous here by design. Report correct_any (either copy) and per-locus recall, not PA alone. Reads that overhang the repeat into unique flank are placeable and form the unambiguous subset.
